name: io.github.jwn7/keys-kept
description: Use API keys from an encrypted .env.age by name. AI tools never receive the values.

environmentVariables.name: VAULT_ENV_PASSPHRASE
environmentVariables.description: Password of the .env.age key file (not the vault master password)

environmentVariables.name: VAULT_ENV_IDENTITY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to your age identity file, for files sealed to your public key
